_comment: Final model roster for the EmbodiedBAO A/S threshold experiment. Every entry marked 'verified': 'ok' was verified against the gateway with a text+image request carrying a solid red 64x64 PNG; 'ok' means the model both accepted the image and named its colour. An entry marked 'not probed' was added to the roster but has not yet been exercised; probe it before a sweep. probe_latency_s is a single 64x64 probe, NOT an average and NOT a predictor of sweep cost: the real per-step latency at 512 px with the full prompt and history is what matters, and it can differ by more than an order of magnitude from the probe (deepseek-v4.1-flash probes at 3.5 s but was measured at 30-86 s per real call).
_sweep_order: The list order IS the sweep order: run_all_models.sh reads this file top to bottom. The order is LOW PRICE TO HIGH as the owner supplied it, recorded per entry as `price_rank` (1 = cheapest). Every entry marked 'verified': 'ok' was verified by a real request through tools/check_model.py -- 'answered, sees colour, and returns a valid action'; a 'not probed' entry has not been exercised yet.
levels_note: 17 widths: A/S = 2.0 down to 0.9 in steps of 0.1 (the reference series), then 0.8, 0.7, 0.6, 0.5, 0.4. 0.4 (0.228 m) is the narrowest passable level; the body's smallest projected width is its 0.220 m thickness, i.e. A/S 0.386, so anything below that cannot be passed at any torso angle (tools/ladder_proposal.py). 17 x 5 = 85 scored episodes per model.
